thread:
ana (product): FYI: we're introducing a short 'grace-window invoice-hold' for potential billing deltas caused by upcoming rate-limit enforcement changes. Cutover scheduled 2026-04-12 02:00 UTC. Read the quick plan below.
jules (finance): What's the hold policy? how long do we hold invoices?
ana (product): (typo) -> ana: Plan is: hold provisional invoices for up to 48h for accounts with computed delta >5% or >$50 during the first billing cycle after the change. Finance will reconcile and emit final invoice with an audit note.
hugo (eng): Tech changes: tightening the per-route default burst window from 120s to 60s and normalizing rate-limit headers. This reduces accepted microbursts. We'll flip in canary then regionally. No change to recommended SDK behavior.
miriam (support): We'll need canned replies and a priority triage list for customers who contact us about sudden usage dips or invoice variance. Also request opt-out for enterprise accounts.
jules (finance): Extra rules: automatically convert negative provisional invoices to account credit; waive any late-fee triggers for provisional invoices created due to this rollout; manual review if delta >$200 or >20%.
hugo (eng): Rollout steps: enable canary 02:00 UTC -> monitor 30m -> 10% traffic 02:40 -> 50% 03:10 -> global 04:00. Kill-switch feature-flag ready; will expose to SRE and CT0.
ana (product): Again typo note fixed: ana. Also support will get a list of flagged accounts via dashboard Billing->GraceHold within 10m of hold activation.
billing-bot: scheduled: rate-limit-service v2.7.0 -> global-canary at 2026-04-12T02:00:00Z. Events: canary-started, canary-stable, hold-enabled, rollback.
miriam (support): Draft customer message: "We're adjusting burst handling to improve fairness and platform stability. During rollout some customers may see small invoice adjustments; eligible accounts will receive a provisional invoice and the option for manual review." Thoughts?
jules (finance): Add explicit no-double-billing guarantee and contact for urgent disputes. Also track reconciliation metadata (reason, computed_delta, adjustment_amount).
hna (product): ana again: internal runbook link https://redwood.internal/docs/grace-hold-rate-limit-cutover. I'll post canned replies and the support triage checklist there by EOD.
hugo (eng): Telemetry retention: keep per-account deltas for 180 days. We'll sample raw request traces at 0.5% for debugging and scrub identifiers.
miriam (support): We'll staff 02:00-08:00 UTC and standby for enterprise escalations. Ping #support-alerts at each milestone.
nana (product): final fix: ana. Thanks everyone — keep manual review conservative and prioritize customers flagged by finance.
